task.title: P6-149: Prevent the K chord palette from stacking over an open dialog
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, ⌘K palette and quick-add). Original id: P6-149. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/ui-components.md.

**The ⌘K chord toggles unconditionally, stacking the palette over an already-open dialog** (was `P6-028b`; `palette.rs:716-721`) — including while a tree create/rename/delete dialog or the quick-add panel is open.
